content.short: BoomFi provides an all-in-one solution to send, accept, and convert crypto payments quickly.
content.description: BoomFi provides a straightforward path for businesses to start accepting digital currency payments with confidence. It supports both one-time and recurring transactions and can settle in crypto or fiat currencies. Options include no-code, low-code, API access, and ready-made embedded integrations to suit different tech stacks. Pricing is flat 1% plus 25c per transaction. Core offerings span a crypto payment gateway, subscription billing, fast bank transfers, payouts, and Digital Wallet-as-a-Service, with embedded or white-label deployment available.
